name: veloria-pos
description: Veloria PoS — Professional Offline-First Retail POS (Windows Desktop, French, DZD)
author: Veloria

scripts.clean:logs: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');for (const f of fs.readdirSync('.')){if(f.endsWith('.log'))try{fs.rmSync(f)}catch{}};for (const p of ['logs']){try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{}}"
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && npx esbuild electron/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --external:electron --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/preload/preload.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/release/stamp-electron-pkg.js && node scripts/licensing/sign-integrity.mjs --if-key-present
scripts.package: npm run license:scan && npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run license:integrity && electron-builder
scripts.package:win: npm run license:scan && npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run license:integrity && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:portable: npm run license:scan && npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run license:integrity && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.build:manager: tsc -p tsconfig.manager.json && node --input-type=commonjs -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-license-manager/license-manager/renderer',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npx esbuild license-manager/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --external:electron --format=cjs --outfile=dist-license-manager/license-manager/preload/preload.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/release/stamp-electron-pkg.js
scripts.build:pos: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.dev:manager: npm run build:manager-client && npm run build:manager && electron ./dist-license-manager/license-manager/main/main.js
scripts.package:manager: npm run license:scan && npm run build:manager-client && npm run build:manager && npm run license:integrity-manager && electron-builder --win -c electron-builder.license-manager.yml
